paragraphs: QQQ is +0.18% versus the prior close. The Nasdaq Score is -32/100 (Cautiously Negative). Score path: pre-market -48 → now -32; open -29 → now -32 (deteriorated 3 points).

The main live drivers are The 2Y rate signal is a headwind: 4.686% (+5.1 bp vs prev close). Volatility are a headwind: VXN 28.71 (-0.03%) | VIX 19.95 (+4.83%). It changed from mixed to negative after the baseline snapshot. Rates are a headwind: the 10Y is 4.986%, -1.1 bp since the opening snapshot.
QQQ and its internal leadership are diverging, so the index move has weaker confirmation (semiconductors positive, mega-caps negative, breadth mixed).

What would change the view: improvement would require further easing in the 10Y toward/below 4.95%, broader participation, VXN/VIX cooling. Deterioration would be reinforced by a renewed 10Y break above roughly 5.05%, semiconductor leadership rolling over.
